nodes.label: HospitALL Logo (frontend/src/assets/logo.png)
nodes.description: Bundled React asset PNG logo for HospitALL. Glyph: a teal/blue rounded shield containing a stylized medical folder with a white medical cross, layered with document/clipboard icons (one bearing a heart), a gear/settings cog, and a stethoscope curve. Palette: deep navy/teal blues (#0E2E4A / #154E6E), mid teal (#2C8FA8), light cyan/mint highlights (#A8DDE5), with white cross and document accents.
nodes.glyph: shield + folder + medical cross + clipboard with heart + gear + stethoscope
